project.name: JPMC KYC Risk Pre-Screening (UBO GraphRAG)
project.business_problem: The client was manually reviewing corporate KYC documents to extract entities, UBOs, and ownership structures, score geographic/industry/sanctions risk, and chase missing policy fields — causing slow onboarding queues, inconsistent scoring, and repetitive follow-up email drafting.
project.solution_summary: An agentic KYC pre-screening platform where analysts upload PDF/TXT/DOCX documents, Azure OpenAI extracts and validates structured KYC data against a configurable policy, computes AI risk scores with explainable reasoning, visualizes ownership graphs, generates DOCX reports, manages a prioritized client queue, and indexes documents with GraphRAG for per-project Q&A.
project.outcomes: Automated entity/UBO extraction from unstructured KYC documents; policy-gated ingestion blocking incomplete submissions; AI risk scores (0–100) with Low/Medium/High tiers and section-level reasoning; analyst queue prioritized by risk_score; downloadable KYC_Risk_Report DOCX; geographic FATF/sanctions exposure dashboard; LLM-drafted client follow-up emails; GraphRAG document Q&A per project.

agents.name: Entity Extraction Agent
agents.function_summary: Extracts entities, ownership relationships, and UBO registry records from uploaded corporate KYC documents into structured JSON for SQL persistence.
outputs: entities array (entity_name, entity_type, jurisdiction, incorporation_date, registered_address)
ubo_registry array (full_name, nationality, ownership_percentage, passport_number, linked_entities)
agents.notes: Uses JSON response_format; generates deterministic ENT/REL/UBO IDs via SHA1 when source IDs absent.

agents.name: KYC Policy Completeness Validator
agents.function_summary: Validates extracted KYC data against kyc_ingestion_policy.json required fields and blocks risk analysis when mandatory pre-KYC information is missing.
inputs: KYC ingestion policy JSON (25+ required fields)
agents.notes: Deterministic post-validation enforces policy required_if and must_be_declared rules (e.g., offshore_exposure_declaration).

agents.name: Missing Information Email Drafter
agents.function_summary: Drafts professional client-facing emails requesting missing KYC details with structured bullet lists and Compliance Team sign-off.
agents.notes: Human-in-the-loop: analyst reviews/edits draft before send via POST /risk-assessment/request-more-info/send.

agents.name: Main Entity Inference Agent
agents.function_summary: Infers the primary corporate entity described in a project's latest document to center the radial ownership visualization.
agents.notes: Exposed via GET /graph/main-entity; fuzzy-matches LLM output to SQL entity names.

agents.name: ML Risk Classifier Stub
agents.function_summary: Rule-based classifier that assigns Low/Medium/High risk tier from engineered geographic, industry, ownership, PEP, and sanctions features.
agents.notes: Not a trained ML model; provides gentle prior for section score calibration in pipeline_full.py.

agents.name: Risk Scoring Agent
agents.function_summary: Aggregates geography (30), ownership (30), regulatory/sanctions (20), and industry (20) scores into a final 0–100 risk score with hard override rules for FATF blacklist, sanctions, circular ownership, and PEP exposure.
agents.model_used: Deterministic scoring + Azure OpenAI gpt-5.1 reasoning
agents.notes: Tier cutoffs: 0–33 Low, 34–66 Medium, 67–100 High; overrides force High tier.

agents.name: Risk Reasoning Generator
agents.function_summary: Generates explainable AI narratives for the final risk score and each of four risk dimensions (Geography, Ownership, Industry, Sanctions) for UI display and DOCX reports.
agents.notes: Runs 6 parallel LLM prompts; strips parentheses/brackets from output; required for risk summary payload validity.

agents.name: UBO Analysis Engine
agents.function_summary: Computes UBO-specific risk score from ownership concentration, identification transparency, structural complexity, and PEP/sanctions/geo flags.
agents.notes: Four 0–25 components: concentration, transparency, complexity, risk_flags.

agents.name: GraphRAG Index & Query Agent
agents.function_summary: Indexes per-project KYC documents into a knowledge graph with entity/community extraction and embeddings; answers analyst questions via local, global, drift, or basic search methods.
agents.model_used: Microsoft GraphRAG with Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2 + text-embedding-3-small
agents.notes: Runs as background thread after upload; exposed via POST /chat and POST /projects/{id}/index.

agents.name: KYC Risk Report Generator
agents.function_summary: Generates downloadable Word (.docx) KYC risk assessment reports with KPI summary table, section scores, UBO details, override status, and AI reasoning narratives.
inputs: entities, ubos, relationships from Azure SQL
agents.notes: Threshold bands documented in report: Low 0–30, Medium 31–55, High 56–100; served via GET /risk-assessment/report.
